title: benkara griffithii
intro: Benkara griffithii, commonly known as Griffith's benkara, is a flowering plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation and the alleviation of symptoms associated with respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Benkara griffithii include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
